title: [DEV] [Premium Lifetime] A Monster Brick Breaker where spam doesn’t work
author: TuHocSolidityCom
selftext:
Hello,  
  
I built **Brick Breaker – Monster Bomb** as a solo indie developer.  
I use **ChatGPT Plus** to help me flesh out game ideas, mechanics, balancing, and level design, then use **CodeX** to turn those detailed designs into working code. It has become my favorite development workflow.

  
**Free Premium Brick Breaker – Monster Bomb Unlock ($3.99) — Lifetime**

Most brick breaker games are basically:

“spam balls and hope it works.”

I wanted something different.

You only get a few balls — so every shot matters.

You actually aim, plan, and set up combos.

Black holes, chain reactions, clean hits…

One perfect shot can clear half the screen.

Less chaos. More skill.
